reason: £280 is a lot on my money when I can find used sets on Marketplace for £150-200 and haggle them down. The check-in-person and refund terms are good, but a new seller with no reviews doesn't beat a cheap set I can negotiate.
objection: Could they be cracked or bent? The photos and balancer report are the seller's own, and with no reviews I'd want to see it myself before believing it. And for £280 I could get a decent used set for much less.
would_change_my_mind: Around £200 a set for my exact fitment, with the chance to see it spun on a balancer at collection and haggle in person.
